INSERT INTO work_items
          (project_id, contract_id, seq, name, spec, unit, quantity, unit_price, unit_cost, amount)
        SELECT $10, $1, * FROM UNNEST(
          $2::int[], $3::text[], $4::text[], $5::text[],
          $6::numeric[], $7::numeric[], $8::numeric[], $9::numeric[]
        )
